sections.kicker: Prepared for Tramuntana by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a traveler planning something rare would. Here is what stood out.
sections.thesis: Tramuntana writes like a luxury house on Instagram and like a booking site on the web.
sections.keep: Your bio line "El lujo de entender cómo te quieres sentir." It names what you sell better than any destination.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.quote: El lujo de entender cómo te quieres sentir.
pins.what: Your bio has the idea that sets you apart.
pins.why: Understanding how a client wants to feel is a promise no travel agency menu can copy.
pins.how: Make this the first line of the site.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The reason to choose you lives on Instagram only.

pins.quote: Experiencias de viaje diseñadas para ti.
pins.what: The site headline is the line every agency uses.
pins.why: Designed for you is what all of them say, so it is why the brand reads like everyone else.
pins.how: Replace it with your own words about feeling, not about trips.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: A new logo on the same sentence still looks like the agency next door.

pins.what: The site switches between English and Spanish in the same screen.
pins.why: A curator's voice is precise, and a mixed menu reads as unfinished.
pins.how: Choose one language per audience and give each a full page.
pins.label: Your language
pins.cost: Clients at this price notice the details before the trips.

sections.intro: You said the brand looks like everyone else, even after the new logo. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Here is why a logo was not enough.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Tramuntana's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Aman, from hospitality. It sells a feeling of being understood, and the places come second.
